# toll-mesh/cache

> 标签: cache, coordination, crdt, distributed, rate-limiting, replica

## 简介

PHP SDK for TollMeshCache - Distributed CRDT-based caching and coordination

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。
